title: So, such, so … that
summary: Nhấn mạnh mức độ và nói kết quả: so + tính từ, such + (a) + tính từ + danh từ, so/such … that.

dialogue.en: It was [[so]] beautiful! We had [[such]] a good time.
dialogue.vi: Đẹp lắm! Bọn mình chơi vui cực kỳ.

dialogue.en: It was [[so]] cold [[that]] we couldn't go out at night.
dialogue.vi: Lạnh đến nỗi tối không ra ngoài được.

dialogue.en: There were [[so many]] good dishes. It was [[such]] delicious food!
dialogue.vi: Nhiều món ngon lắm. Đồ ăn ngon tuyệt!

sections.heading: So + tính từ, such + danh từ
sections.rule: **so + tính từ / trạng từ** (so tired, so fast). **such + (a/an) + tính từ + danh từ** (such a nice day, such kind people).

formula.text: [such a / an] + adj + danh từ số ít
[such] + adj + danh từ số nhiều / không đếm được

body: Cả hai đều nghĩa là *rất, quá, đến thế*, nhưng mạnh và giàu cảm xúc hơn *very*.
Với số lượng: **so many** + danh từ đếm được, **so much** + danh từ không đếm được.

examples.vi: Đó là một bộ phim chán đến thế.
examples.why: Such a + tính từ + danh từ số ít.

examples.vi: Họ là những người thân thiện quá.
examples.why: Danh từ số nhiều → such, không có a.

check.prompt: It was ___ hot day that we stayed inside.

sections.heading: So / such … that: đến nỗi mà
sections.rule: Nói **kết quả** của mức độ: **so + tính từ + that…** hoặc **such (a) + tính từ + danh từ + that…** (đến nỗi mà).

examples.en: I was [[so]] tired [[that]] I fell asleep on the bus.
examples.vi: Tôi mệt đến nỗi ngủ quên trên xe buýt.

examples.en: It was [[such]] a good offer [[that]] I couldn't say no.
examples.vi: Lời mời hấp dẫn đến nỗi tôi không thể từ chối.
examples.why: Such a + adj + danh từ + that.

examples.vi: Cô ấy nói nhanh đến nỗi không ai hiểu.

check.prompt: The coffee was ___ strong that I couldn't sleep.

sections.heading: So many, so much
sections.rule: **so many** + danh từ **đếm được** số nhiều; **so much** + danh từ **không đếm được**.

examples.en: There were [[so many]] people at the market.
I have [[so much]] work this week.
examples.vi: Tuần này tôi nhiều việc quá.
examples.why: Work không đếm được → so much.

check.prompt: I ate ___ food that I felt sick.
check.explain: Food không đếm được → so much.

mistakes.wrong: It was so a beautiful day.
mistakes.right: It was such a beautiful day.

mistakes.wrong: They are such a nice people.
It was such cold that we stayed home.
mistakes.right: It was so cold that we stayed home.
mistakes.why: Chỉ có tính từ → so … that.

exercises.prompt: The test was ___ difficult that half the class failed.

options: It was such a long trip.
It was so a long trip.
exercises.explain: Such a + adj + danh từ số ít.

exercises.prompt: We had ___ a great time in Hoi An.
answers: such

exercises.prompt: The music was ___ loud that I couldn't hear you.
answers: so

exercises.prompt: There were ___ many cars that we couldn't move.
answers: so

exercises.prompt: It was such a sad film ___ I cried.
answers: that

exercises.prompt: She has ___ much money that she doesn't need to work.
answers: so

exercises.vi: Hôm nay là một ngày nóng quá.
Tôi mệt đến nỗi không ăn được.

exercises.sentence: It was so a good party.
answers: It was such a good party.

exercises.sentence: We had such fun that we didn't want to leave, and the food was such good.
answers: We had such fun that we didn't want to leave, and the food was so good.
exercises.explain: Chỉ có tính từ → so good.

exercises.sentence: There were so much tourists in Hoi An.
answers: There were so many tourists in Hoi An.

exercises.vi: Cô ấy là một người tốt bụng đến thế.
answers: She is such a kind person.
She's such a kind person.
She is such a nice person.
She's such a nice person.
She is such a kind-hearted person.

exercises.vi: Trời lạnh đến nỗi chúng tôi ở nhà.
answers: It was so cold that we stayed home.
It was so cold that we stayed at home.
It was so cold we stayed home.
It was so cold we stayed at home.
It's so cold that we're staying home.
It's so cold that we're staying at home.
It is so cold that we are staying home.
It is so cold that we are staying at home.
